about:
Electronic Connections Inc is a privately held electronics distributor headquartered in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, with a second location in Manchester Township, New Jersey. The company was founded in 1994 by Steve Jordan, who established the business on a philosophy of total customer satisfaction.

The firm stocks and supplies interconnect, passive, and electro‑mechanical components from more than 200 authorized product lines. Beyond distribution, it provides value‑added services including custom labeling and marking, custom component and connector modification and assembly, custom DIN‑rail design and assembly, and cable assembly technology.

Electronic Connections serves primarily the aerospace and defense sectors. Its authorized lines include products from Bendix (Amphenol Aerospace), ITT Cannon, Deutsch Defense/Aerospace, Positronic Industries, and Harbour Industries, among others, indicating a customer base of aerospace and defense manufacturers and contractors.

The company states that its founding principle was to meet and exceed customer expectations through total customer satisfaction, a commitment it continues to emphasize in its sales and support approach.
